RY-L03-S01-A01.title: Egregores
RY-L03-S01-A01.description: Conscious connection with a chosen egregore and practice from its symbolic centre.
RY-L03-S01-A01.effect: Intended to provide a sense of support, protection and resource from the selected field.

RY-L03-S01-A02.title: Exorcism
RY-L03-S01-A02.description: A source-tradition cleansing practice for unwanted subtle influences.
RY-L03-S01-A02.effect: Intended to restore a sense of integrity and free up personal resource.

RY-L03-S01-A03.title: Guardian Angel
RY-L03-S01-A03.description: Activation of a symbolic connection with one's guardian angel.
RY-L03-S01-A03.effect: Intended to strengthen the sense of guidance and protection.

RY-L03-S01-A04.title: Healer
RY-L03-S01-A04.description: Healing-oriented practice through the hands and subtle-body imagery.
RY-L03-S01-A04.effect: Intended to make state-focused practice gentler and more structured.

RY-L03-S02-A01.title: KHAT
RY-L03-S02-A01.description: Anchoring in the body and the present incarnation in the Egyptian source model.
RY-L03-S02-A01.effect: Intended to strengthen presence in the selected point of space.

RY-L03-S02-A02.title: KA
RY-L03-S02-A02.description: Working with emotional motivation and synchronisation with the KHAT body.
RY-L03-S02-A02.effect: Intended to strengthen personal coherence and emotional impulse.

RY-L03-S02-A03.title: BA
RY-L03-S02-A03.description: Working with the subtle body of attention and interaction.
RY-L03-S02-A03.effect: Intended to direct attention more precisely and manage contact.

RY-L03-S02-A04.title: EB / AB
RY-L03-S02-A04.description: Balancing actions and harmonising the KA–BA connection.
RY-L03-S02-A04.effect: Intended to support a steadier and more responsible state.

RY-L03-S02-A05.title: KHAIBIT
RY-L03-S02-A05.description: Working with the event layer in the source model.
RY-L03-S02-A05.effect: Intended to improve awareness of events and their possible correction.

RY-L03-S02-A06.title: KHU
RY-L03-S02-A06.description: Working with luminosity and deep memory.
RY-L03-S02-A06.effect: Intended to open memories and a sense of inner light.

RY-L03-S02-A07.title: SAHU
RY-L03-S02-A07.description: Integration of subtle bodies into a stronger structure.
RY-L03-S02-A07.effect: Intended to gather and strengthen a sense of personal wholeness.

RY-L03-S02-A08.title: SEKHEM
RY-L03-S02-A08.description: Connection with processes, bodies and divine levels of the Egyptian tradition.
RY-L03-S02-A08.effect: Intended to support an experience of connection with a wider field of power.

RY-L03-S02-A09.title: REN
RY-L03-S02-A09.description: Working with the name as a fixed identity structure.
RY-L03-S02-A09.effect: Intended to strengthen identity and coherence of the subtle-body model.

RY-L03-S03-A01.title: Planets
RY-L03-S03-A01.description: Attunement to planetary energies in the course's symbolic model.
RY-L03-S03-A01.effect: Intended to strengthen potential and add energy.

RY-L03-S03-A02.title: Constellations
RY-L03-S03-A02.description: Working with behavioural patterns and symbolic influence on events.
RY-L03-S03-A02.effect: Intended to identify strong qualities and amplify them.

RY-L03-S03-A03.title: Adam Kadmon
RY-L03-S03-A03.description: Integrating planets and constellations into the person's energetic model.
RY-L03-S03-A03.effect: Intended to strengthen social expression and realisation.

RY-L03-S03-A04.title: Geniuses
RY-L03-S03-A04.description: Working with energies associated with zodiac signs.
RY-L03-S03-A04.effect: Intended to use the qualities of a sign more precisely.

RY-L03-S03-A05.title: Ophonim
RY-L03-S03-A05.description: Attunement to energies associated with shaping the future.
RY-L03-S03-A05.effect: Used to explore future development options.

RY-L03-S04-A01.title: Intention
RY-L03-S04-A01.effect: Intended to work with will, attention and manifestation in the world.

RY-L03-S04-A02.title: Second Attention
RY-L03-S04-A02.description: Working with attention control and perception of subtle-body imagery.
RY-L03-S04-A02.effect: Intended to see a situation more broadly and deeply.

RY-L03-S04-A03.title: Wheel of Time
RY-L03-S04-A03.description: Working with event flow and choosing a preferred development option.
RY-L03-S04-A03.effect: Intended to redirect an event trajectory through attention and intention.

RY-L03-S04-A04.title: Dreaming Gates
RY-L03-S04-A04.description: Entering lucid-dreaming practice and perceiving parallel probabilities.
RY-L03-S04-A04.effect: Intended to broaden perception of the world and event processes.

RY-L03-S05-A01.title: Teachers
RY-L03-S05-A01.description: Invoking spiritual teachers as symbolic guides on the Path.
RY-L03-S05-A01.effect: Intended to provide support in development and difficult situations.

RY-L03-S05-A02.title: Dhikr
RY-L03-S05-A02.description: Working with sacred names and rhythmic spiritual practice.
RY-L03-S05-A02.effect: Intended to deepen engagement with the tradition and shift one's state.

RY-L03-S05-A03.title: Body of Light
RY-L03-S05-A03.description: Formation of the 'Body of Light' and attunement to the upper astral in the source tradition.
RY-L03-S05-A03.effect: Intended to evoke a subtler, brighter state of consciousness.
